subject: OrionHealth private-offer MAP, eval criteria & billing path
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orionhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Initial request: MAP + private offer details for OrionHealth production cutover

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the performance numbers. Procurement and cloud ops asked me to put together a short mutual action plan so we can align on the evaluation acceptance gates, procurement milestones, and the billing path for an AWS private offer. High-level asks from our side: 

- Evaluation acceptance criteria (latency P50/P95 targets, cost per 1M tokens estimate, security checklist items).
- Proposed MAP with milestones (PO, legal sign-off, marketplace private-offer activation, production cutover).
- Billing path: we prefer an AWS private offer that invoices via marketplace (monthly invoice) but need clarity on escrow/SPoC and any required PO number on signature.
- Timeline: aiming to be production-ready by 2026-12-20; is that feasible?

Can you send a draft MAP and a short list of required docs/clauses for legal and finance? I can loop in our procurement mailbox (procurement@orionhealth.com) and Cloud Security for evidence.

Thanks — Marta
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, OrionHealth

Attachments: none (initial request)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: MAP + private offer details for OrionHealth production cutover

Hi Marta — great to hear. Thanks for outlining priorities.

I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MutualActionPlan_ORION_v0.1.xlsx) and a short checklist we use for marketplace private-offers (AWS/GCP/Azure). Quick answers up front:

- Feasibility: Aiming for 2026-12-20 is tight but possible if procurement/legal move within 10 business days to sign the private-offer/PO.
- Billing: We support AWS marketplace private-offer activation; finance can invoice via marketplace monthly. Grace, see the billing bullets below for questions.
- Docs we usually need: signed private-offer acceptance, PO number (if required by customer), SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM posture summary if you require key custody on customer side.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week 0 (today): Share MAP & terms; schedule technical acceptance window.
2) Week 1: Evaluation run + acceptance tests (latency + throughput + cost sample)
3) Week 2: Legal review & redline of private-offer terms
4) Week 3: PO issuance & DocuSign acceptance; marketplace private-offer activation
5) Week 4: Staged production cutover + monitoring handoff

I'll ask Karthik to take the lead on legal redlines and Grace on billing cadence. Uploading the MAP now.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_ORION_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Marketplace_Checklist.md (checklist)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: OrionHealth MAP — callouts for legal & finance

Karthik/Grace — quick internal note after Marta's ask. Key items to flag: 

- Data residency & retention: Orion wants confirmation that KV cache won't be persisted outside of their tenancy for Private deployment. If we offer Hosted fallback, we must document the fallback policy.
- KMS: They asked about customer-managed keys. For marketplace private-offer, outline if and when KMS integration is available; otherwise state Redwood-managed KMS with audit logs.
- PO vs DocuSign: They prefer marketplace invoicing but will issue a PO if required. Confirm whether we need a PO number to activate the private offer on AWS.
- SLA exceptions during cutover: propose a 48-hour rollback window.

Can you draft a short redline summary we can send to Marta to move legal along? Grace — can you confirm the billing path (monthly marketplace invoice) and any setup lead times on finance side?

Thanks,
Camila

On Wed, Nov 12, 2026 at 11:02 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Marta — great to hear. Thanks for outlining priorities.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orionhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-20T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: OrionHealth private-offer MAP, eval criteria & billing path

Hi Marta / Camila — I reviewed the MAP and drafted a short set of redlines and clarifying notes; summary below and attached full redline (Redwood_AWS_Private_Offer_Ts.pdf).

Summary of changes we request:
- Clause 3.2 (Data handling): Clarify that for "Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem)" deployments, customer-managed KMS can be used; for hosted/dedicated, Redwood-managed KMS applies unless otherwise agreed.
- Clause 5.1 (Retention): Add explicit 90-day default KV cache retention and an option for shorter retention on request.
- Clause 7.4 (Marketplace activation): Require explicit PO number or signed acceptance to activate private-offer. Can accept PO emailed to procurement@redwood.ai as alternative to DocuSign in tight timelines.
- Limitation of liability: small tightening on refund windows during early production.

Next steps requested from Orion: please confirm whether PO issuance will be possible within 7 business days after legal sign-off. Also, please confirm the exact contact for invoicing (name + email).

Attaching full PDF redline. Camila — if they ask, we can accept PO-to-marketplace flow and proceed to activation once payment terms are set.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_AWS_Private_Offer_Ts.pdf

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orionhealth.com>

Subject: Re: OrionHealth private-offer MAP, eval criteria & billing path — PO issued

Camila / Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround.

We validated the redlines with our legal team and confirm we can accept the modifications. Procurement issued PO OR-569 today and attached the signed SOW. We will proceed with marketplace private-offer activation via AWS once Redwood confirms the activation ticket and sends a DocuSign link for signature of the final acceptance.

Quick billing notes:
- Invoicing: monthly via AWS marketplace (please confirm the invoice name and billing contact).
- PO: OR-569 included in the DocuSign envelope as reference.

Next step for Redwood: share the DocuSign link for acceptance (or confirm you can accept PO by email) and open the AWS private-offer activation ticket.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, OrionHealth
